description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDependentService class, which provides methods to manage employee dependents in the HRM system, including CRUD operations and searching dependents with exception handling.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee dependents, providing methods to retrieve, save, delete, and search dependents with exception handling.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependentDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmployeeDependentDao instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of dependents for a given employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dependent based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: saveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Saves an employee dependent and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Deletes dependents for an employee based on entries to delete.

methods.name: searchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Searches dependents based on filter parameters, with exception handling.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of dependents matching search criteria, with exception handling.
